title: 英语进阶用法与句型（平台自建）
subject: english
sourceNote: 由同路平台自行编写的进阶用法练习，考查倒装、虚拟语气、非谓语等较复杂结构。不是任何考试的真题，也不对应任何考试的具体分数。

questions.prompt: Not until he got home ___ that he had left his keys in the office.
questions.explanation: Not until 放句首引起**部分倒装**：助动词提到主语前，实义动词还原原形，所以是 did he realize。这是最常考的倒装结构之一。

questions.prompt: ___ I known the truth, I would have acted differently.
questions.explanation: 虚拟语气中 if 省略后要**倒装**：Had I known = If I had known。这是与过去事实相反的假设，主句用 would have done。

questions.prompt: The report, ___ by a team of experts, was published last week.
questions.explanation: report 与 write 是被动关系，且动作已完成，用过去分词 written 作后置定语（= which was written）。writing 表主动，to write 表将来。

questions.prompt: It is essential that every student ___ the safety rules.
questions.explanation: It is essential/necessary/important that... 引导的主语从句要用**虚拟语气**：should + 动词原形，should 可省略，所以用 follow（原形），不加 -s。

questions.prompt: Only when the rain stopped ___ the extent of the damage.
questions.explanation: Only + 状语从句放句首，主句要**部分倒装**。主句时态与从句 stopped 呼应，用过去时 could，倒装为 could they see。

questions.prompt: He regretted ___ her the bad news so bluntly.
questions.explanation: regret doing = 后悔做过某事（动作已发生）；regret to do = 遗憾要去做某事（动作未发生）。已经说了坏消息，所以用 telling。

questions.prompt: The more we practice, ___ we become.
questions.explanation: the more...the more... 是「越……越……」的固定结构，两边都要用 the + 比较级，所以是 the more confident we become。

questions.prompt: It was in the library ___ he first met his future wife.
questions.explanation: 这是**强调句** It was...that...，强调地点状语 in the library。强调句的判据：去掉 It was 和 that，剩下的 it 换成原句仍成立（In the library he first met...）。
